channel.title: Gradify: new study guides and tools
channel.description: New free study guides, tools, checklists and features from Gradify.

item.title: What's new: Faster and easier to cite
item.description: Pages load their font from Gradify itself, with no third-party request. Cite this page on guides, comparisons, key terms and research (HTML, APA and Harvard). Smaller link-preview images

item.title: What's new: Every page leads somewhere useful
item.description: Guides and comparisons show the tools for each step, common pitfalls and a rule of thumb. Tools explain how to read the result, which tool to use when, and the traps to watch. Series (exam season, coursework, science practicals) with previous and next. Tools, guides and checklists grouped by where you are: weeks to go, exam next week, coursework due, results

item.title: What's new: Key terms, research and better links
item.description: Key terms A to Z: plain-English definitions and how meanings change between subjects. Research: common-mistake warnings counted across every subject. Topic pages link to the same ideas in other subjects, and answer the questions students ask. Study-technique words link to their glossary entries wherever they appear

item.title: What's new: Free tools, checklists and topic quizzes
item.description: 30 free tools, including a cram planner, deadline planner, study timer, shared focus room, citation helper and mark-scheme checker. Every topic page now has a quick quiz, a 60-second recall drill, Listen, printable cheat sheets, blurting sheets and index cards, and a full Anki/Quizlet CSV export. Nine printable checklists, from lab reports to exam day. Practice questions and exam traps for every subject. 25 new study guides and 10 concept comparisons

item.title: What's new: Free study pages
item.description: Free degree, GPA and final-grade calculators. Topic pages for every unit of every live course, and week-by-week study plans. Study guides, comparisons, a glossary and printable templates

item.title: What's new: Five sections in the app
item.description: The app's navigation went from 15 destinations to five sections

item.title: Send to Gradify Bookmarklet: Any Webpage to Flashcards
item.description: Drag the Send to Gradify button to your bookmarks bar. Highlight text on any page (Wikipedia, PubMed, BBC Bitesize) and turn it into checked flashcards.

item.title: UK Degree Classification Calculator (1st, 2:1, 2:2) · Free
item.description: Free UK degree calculator: enter your module marks and credits for year 2 and your final year, choose the weighting, and see your classification, with borderline cases flagged.

item.title: Final Exam Grade Calculator: What Do I Need on My Final?
item.description: Free final grade calculator: enter your current grade, how much the final is worth and your target, and see exactly what you need to score on the final exam.

item.title: Weighted Grade Calculator for Modules and Courses · Free
item.description: Free weighted grade calculator: add each assessment's score and weight to see your current module average, the marks banked so far, and how much is left to play for.

item.title: GPA Calculator (4.0 Scale) for College and University
item.description: Free GPA calculator on the US 4.0 scale: add each course's letter grade and credit hours to get your semester or cumulative GPA.

item.title: Exam Countdown & Revision Hours Calculator · Free
item.description: How many days until your exam, and how many real revision hours do you have? Free exam countdown with study-hours planning, an embeddable widget and a shareable story card.

item.title: Spaced Repetition Schedule Generator (with Calendar File)
item.description: Free spaced repetition schedule: enter when you learn a topic and your exam date, get review dates at 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days, and download them to your calendar.

item.title: Cram Planner: Revise in 48 Hours (Free Triage Plan)
item.description: Exam in 2 days? Enter the hours left and your topics and get a ruthless triage plan: high-yield concepts, past-paper gaps, rapid recall, then sleep.

item.title: Coursework Deadline Planner with a 48-Hour Buffer
item.description: Enter your coursework deadline, hours needed and study days a week. Get daily hours, dated milestones and a 48-hour buffer, as a calendar file.

item.title: Exam Timetable Planner: Revise for Back-to-Back Exams
item.description: Add 2 to 8 exams with dates, weight and difficulty. Get a day-by-day revision order that gives heavy, close exams their time first. Free.

item.title: Study Hours Calculator: How Long Should I Revise?
item.description: Enter lecture hours, weeks until exams and your confidence, and get the total revision hours and a weekly budget for the module. Free.

item.title: Academic Reading Time Calculator (Pages or Text)
item.description: How long will 30 pages take? Enter pages or paste text, choose how dense it is, and see reading time plus time for notes and spaced reviews.

item.title: Topic Prioritiser: What Should I Revise First?
item.description: List up to 10 topics with how much they're worth and how confident you are. Get them sorted: urgent and high-yield first, build confidence next, polish later.

item.title: Winter Break Revision Planner for January Exams
item.description: Plan the winter break before January exams or resits: rest days first, light spaced-repetition days, then focused exam blocks. Day by day, free.

item.title: Dissertation Word Count Calculator by Chapter
item.description: Split a 10,000-word dissertation into chapter word counts (abstract, introduction, literature review, methods, results, discussion) and a daily target.

item.title: Module Grade Calculator: Exam Mark Needed for a 2:1
item.description: Enter your coursework marks and weights and your target (pass, 2:1, First, merit, distinction). See the exact exam mark you need, plus a safe buffer.

item.title: Grade Boundary Checker for Past Papers · Free
item.description: Paste your exam board's grade boundaries for a past paper and your raw mark, and see your grade, your percentage and how many marks to the next grade.

item.title: Science Unit Converter: mg, µg, mol, dm³, kJ
item.description: Convert the units that cost marks: mass, volume, moles, concentration, energy, pressure, length and time, with the multiplying factor and a sanity check.

item.title: Pomodoro Study Timer with Brown Noise (25/5, 50/10)
item.description: A free, distraction-free study timer: 25/5 or 50/10 Pomodoro, brown noise or rain made in your browser, break ideas, and a one-line reflection after each block.

item.title: Shared Study Timer: Focus Room for Study Groups
item.description: A free 'study with me' room: everyone with the link sees the same 50/10 timer, synced to the clock. Share it in Discord or a group chat. No sign-up.

item.title: 60-Second Exam Stress Reset: Breathe, Then One Task
item.description: Frozen before an exam? One minute of paced breathing (in 4, hold 4, out 6), then pick one 10-minute task: three quiz questions or a single flashcard deck.

item.title: Exam Mistake Log: Track Why You Lose Marks
item.description: Log every question you get wrong, why (misread, forgot, concept, rushed, guessed) and the right rule. See your mistake pattern and drill the weak spots.

item.title: Syllabus Coverage Checker: Have I Revised Everything?
item.description: Paste your exam specification (AQA, OCR, Edexcel or a module syllabus) and your notes. See which specification points your notes cover and which are missing.

item.title: Mark Scheme Checker: Compare Your Answer to the Scheme
item.description: Paste a mark scheme and your answer. See which marking points your answer mentions and which keywords you missed. Free, private, no sign-up.

item.title: Free Citation Generator: Harvard, APA, Vancouver, IEEE
item.description: Format a journal article, book or web page reference in Harvard, APA 7, Vancouver or IEEE, with the in-text citation. Free, no sign-up, nothing stored.

item.title: Essay Outline Generator: Paragraph Plan with Word Counts
item.description: Enter your essay question, word count and argument. Get a paragraph-by-paragraph plan (introduction, points, counter-argument, conclusion) with word counts.

item.title: Seminar Prep Helper: Talking Points from a Reading
item.description: Enter a reading, its main claim and one limitation. Get three seminar talking points and two questions to ask the group, so you're never silent in a tutorial.

item.title: Presentation Timing Planner: Slides per Minute
item.description: Enter your presentation length and main points. Get a slide-by-slide timing plan, spoken word counts at 130 words a minute, and likely questions.

item.title: Viva Prep: Practice Questions for a Project Defence
item.description: Enter your project, main finding and biggest limitation. Get practice viva questions on methodology, limitations and next steps, to rehearse out loud.

item.title: Research Question Generator: PICO, SPIDER and FINER
item.description: Turn a broad topic into a focused research question with PICO, SPIDER and FINER: three versions (too broad, focused, analytical) and a feasibility check.

item.title: Literature Review Helper: Group Sources into Themes
item.description: Add your sources and how each relates to the main view. Get a thematic structure (agreement, tensions, gap) instead of a list of 'Author A said…'.

item.title: Group Project Planner: Split Tasks Fairly · Free
item.description: Enter your group members, tasks with rough hours and the deadline. Get a balanced task split and three internal check-ins, ready to paste into the group chat.

item.title: Exam Question Breakdown: Command Words and Marks
item.description: Paste an exam question and its marks. Get the command word and what it wants, a four-step plan for the answer, and a time guide per mark.

item.title: GCSE exam countdown: Days Left and Revision Hours (2027)
item.description: How many days until GCSE exams? A free countdown from an estimated 2027 start date (change it to yours), with revision hours left.

item.title: A level exam countdown: Days Left and Revision Hours (2027)
item.description: How many days until A level exams? A free countdown from an estimated 2027 start date (change it to yours), with revision hours left.

item.title: University finals countdown: Days Left and Revision Hours (2027)
item.description: How many days until University finalss? A free countdown from an estimated 2027 start date (change it to yours), with revision hours left.

item.title: Lab Report Checklist: Structure and Common Mistakes
item.description: A free interactive lab report checklist: aim, hypothesis, method and controls, results with uncertainty, discussion of limitations and conclusion. Saves your ticks.

item.title: University Semester Reset Checklist (Start of Term)
item.description: A start-of-term reset for university: audit your modules and assessments, set up folders and a spaced-repetition routine, and do a baseline quiz. Saves your progress.

item.title: Exam Day Checklist: What to Bring and Do
item.description: A free exam day checklist: student ID, pens, calculator in the right mode, timetable and room, water, timing plan and a calm start. Print it or tick it off.

item.title: Proofreading Checklist for Essays and Reports · Free
item.description: Proofread like a marker: argument and content, structure and signposting, then formatting, units and references. An interactive checklist that saves your ticks.

item.title: Peer Review Checklist: Give Useful Feedback on a Draft
item.description: Give a coursemate useful feedback instead of 'looks good': prompts for essays, lab reports, presentations and code or data projects, with a summary to paste back.

item.title: STEM Practical Exam Checklist (Lab Assessments)
item.description: Prepare for a science practical exam or required practicals: techniques, safety, recording results, uncertainty and the write-up questions examiners ask.

item.title: Coursework Submission Checklist: Before You Press Submit
item.description: The final checks before submitting coursework: the brief, word count, file format, references, academic integrity declaration and a confirmation receipt.

item.title: Final 48 Hours Before an Exam: Checklist · Free
item.description: The last two days before an exam: past-paper gaps, rapid recall of weak cards, formula and definition sheets, logistics, sleep. A calm, prioritised checklist.

item.title: Critical Analysis Checklist: From Descriptive to First-Class
item.description: Check each paragraph for critical analysis: a claim, evidence, evaluation of that evidence, comparison with other sources, and a link back to your argument.

item.title: Active Recall: The Complete Guide for University Exams (2026)
item.description: What active recall is, the research behind it, and a step-by-step method for using it with flashcards, blank pages and past papers to revise for university and A level exams.

item.title: Active Recall vs Re-reading Notes: Which Works Better?
item.description: Re-reading feels productive but fades fast. Here's what the research says about active recall vs re-reading, and how to switch a re-reading habit to self-testing in one evening.

item.title: How to Use Active Recall for Science Subjects (Biology, Chemistry, Physics)
item.description: Active recall for science: flashcards for definitions, blank-page diagrams for processes, and worked problems for calculations. A method for GCSE, A level and university sciences.

item.title: The Best Active Recall Schedule Before Finals (6-Week Plan)
item.description: A week-by-week active recall and spaced repetition schedule for the six weeks before university finals or A levels, with what to do each day and how to fit in past papers.

item.title: How to Make Good Flashcards: 9 Rules That Actually Work
item.description: Nine rules for making effective flashcards: one idea per card, questions not topics, cloze deletions, images, and why your cards must match your own course notes.

item.title: How to Revise in 2 Weeks (When You've Left It Late)
item.description: Two weeks until your exam? A realistic day-by-day plan: triage topics, turn notes into flashcards fast, use active recall and past papers, and protect your sleep.

item.title: 7 Best Study Tools for University Students in 2026 (Honest Comparison)
item.description: An honest comparison of the best study tools for university students in 2026: Anki, Quizlet, Notion, RemNote, Forest, Google NotebookLM and Gradify, with who each one suits.

item.title: Exam Command Words Explained (State, Explain, Evaluate)
item.description: What state, describe, explain, compare, evaluate and 'to what extent' want, with weak vs full-mark answers. For GCSE, A level, IB and university exams.

item.title: Exam Question Stems and How to Answer Each One
item.description: Common exam question stems (account for, suggest why, compare the mechanisms, design an investigation) with a step-by-step response skeleton for each.
